prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · API 参数说明 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "参数" · longest unbreakable word 122px · one-line width 122px
  col 2: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 3: header "必填" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "默认值" · longest unbreakable word 82px · one-line width 82px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 97px · one-line width 488px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"说明 API 各参数的名称、类型、是否必填、默认值及用途，供开发者配置请求时查阅。","reading":"读者先按参数名定位，再横向核对类型、必填状态和默认值，最后阅读说明；也可能纵向比较各参数的必填状态或默认值。说明换行产生的行高可供同一行的其他单元格使用。","groups":["参数和类型共同标识字段及其数据类型，适合相邻扫描。","必填和默认值共同说明调用时是否需要提供值，以及省略后的行为。","说明补充参数的用途，应尽量让读者在首屏看到其起始位置。"],"keep_intact":["参数名，如 include_deleted 和 callback_url","类型名，如 string 和 enum","默认值中的标识符，如 created_at","必填等表头及说明中的代码词"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文句子可按自然阅读位置换行。","空间不足时，参数名和默认值可以拆分，但会降低识别和复制时的便利性。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [143, 70, 52, 103, 180] · table 549×498px · row heights [36, 83, 106, 106, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 189px
Design r2B: widths [132, 70, 52, 103, 170] · table 528×498px · row heights [36, 83, 106, 106, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 1 · OVERFLOWS the box by 168px
Design r2C: widths [143, 70, 52, 103, 130] · table 499×567px · row heights [36, 106, 129, 106, 83, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 139px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"参数名、类型和默认值按给定数据均可保持完整；说明列较宽，中文句子有较从容的换行空间，行高也较均衡。","problems":"首屏看不到说明列，默认值末端也需要横向滚动才能查看；整表横向距离较长。","cause":"前四列合计368px，已超过360px视口；说明列180px使总宽达到549px。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"类型、必填和默认值保留了r2A的宽度；说明列仍有足够空间，表格高度与r2A相同，总宽略有减少。","problems":"参数列出现一次单词中途拆分，损害按名称定位的速度；说明列依然位于首屏之外，节省的横向距离也有限。","cause":"参数列132px只能容纳111px文本，小于最长参数名的122px；前四列合计357px，说明列几乎全部在视口之外。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"总宽比前两个方案小，横向滚动距离较短；较窄的说明列仍保留了阅读说明的独立区域。","problems":"说明列变窄后，更多句子换行，整表增高，行内其他单元格的空白也随之增加。图中include_deleted似乎被拆成两行，但给定指标报告中途拆分为零，二者存在出入。","cause":"说明列130px只有109px文本宽度，最长单元格达到5行；按所给宽度，参数列143px恰好容纳122px的最长标识符，图中拆分现象需要复核。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-scroll","widths":[143,70,52,103,150],"change":"保留能够容纳完整参数名、类型、必填表头和默认值的宽度，将说明列设为150px；在r2A和r2C之间折中说明的换行密度与横向滚动距离。"},{"name":"description-at-edge","widths":[143,70,52,94,150],"change":"将默认值列缩至94px，使说明列从359px处开始，便于首屏边缘提示后方还有内容；代价是最长默认值可能拆分，需检查其对识别的影响。"},{"name":"compact-first-view","widths":[132,70,52,92,160],"change":"同时压缩参数和默认值列，让说明列从346px处开始，并给说明较宽的阅读空间；用于比较首屏提示和较短滚动距离是否值得付出标识符拆分的代价。"}]}
